title: JavaScript Complete Cheat Sheet
description: Comprehensive quick reference for modern JavaScript: ES6+ syntax, async patterns, DOM manipulation, closures, prototypes, and functional programming.

data.text: Modern JavaScript (ES6+) provides powerful features for building interactive web applications.

data.title: var vs let vs const
data.content: var is function-scoped, let and const are block-scoped.

data.title: Temporal Dead Zone
data.content: let and const are not accessible before declaration.

data.title: Primitive Types & typeof
data.code:
typeof 'hello'    // 'string'
typeof 42         // 'number'
typeof true       // 'boolean'
typeof undefined  // 'undefined'
typeof null       // 'object' (known bug)
typeof Symbol()   // 'symbol'
typeof 10n        // 'bigint'

typeof {}         // 'object'
typeof []         // 'object'
typeof function(){} // 'function'

data.title: Type Coercion
data.code:
// Implicit coercion
'5' + 3     // '53'
'5' - 3     // 2
'5' * '2'   // 10

// Explicit conversion
Number('5')    // 5
String(5)      // '5'
Boolean(1)     // true
parseInt('10') // 10
parseFloat('3.14') // 3.14

data.title: Logical & Nullish Coalescing
data.code:
// Logical AND returns first falsy value
true && 'hello'  // 'hello'
false && 'hello' // false

// Logical OR returns first truthy value
'fallback' || 'default' // 'fallback'
null || 'default'       // 'default'

// Nullish coalescing (only null/undefined)
null ?? 'default'       // 'default'
0 ?? 'default'          // 0
'' ?? 'default'         // ''
undefined ?? 'default'  // 'default'

Template Literals & Methods
data.code:
// Template literals
const name = 'John';
const greeting = `Hello, ${name}!`;

// String methods
'hello'.includes('ell');        // true
'hello'.startsWith('he');       // true
'hello'.endsWith('lo');         // true
'hi'.padStart(5, '!');          // '!!!hi'
'hi'.padEnd(5, '!');            // 'hi!!!'
'ha'.repeat(3);                 // 'hahaha'
'a,b,c'.split(',');             // ['a', 'b', 'c']
['a','b'].join('-');            // 'a-b'
'hello'.replace('l', 'L');      // 'heLlo'
'hello'.slice(1, 3);            // 'el'
'hello'.indexOf('l');           // 2
